verses.text: Yahweh told Moses:

“Tell the Israelites this too: ‘If anyone from Israel, or any foreigner living in Israel, gives one of their children to Molech, that person must be put to death. The people of the land will stone them.
I’ll turn against that person myself and cut them off from their people, because they gave one of their children to Molech, defiling my sanctuary and dishonoring my holy name.
If the people of the land turn a blind eye when someone gives one of their children to Molech and they don’t put that person to death,
I’ll turn against that person and their family. I’ll cut them off from their people, along with everyone who follows them in being unfaithful with Molech.
“‘If someone turns to mediums and wizards and goes after them in unfaithfulness, I’ll turn against that person and cut them off from their people.
“‘Set yourselves apart and be holy, because I’m Yahweh your God.
Keep my laws and put them into practice. I’m Yahweh, the one who makes you holy.
“‘Anyone who curses their father or mother must be put to death. They cursed their own parent, and their blood is on their own head.
“‘If a man commits adultery with another man’s wife, his neighbor’s wife, both the man and the woman who committed adultery must be put to death.
“‘A man who sleeps with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both must be put to death. Their blood is on their own heads.
“‘If a man sleeps with his daughter-in-law, both must be put to death. They’ve committed a perversion. Their blood is on their own heads.
“‘If a man sleeps with a man as he would with a woman, both have done what is detestable. They must be put to death. Their blood is on their own heads.
“‘If a man takes both a woman and her mother as wives, that’s wicked. All three must be burned so that there’s no such wickedness among you.
“‘If a man sleeps with an animal, he must be put to death, and you must kill the animal too.
“‘If a woman approaches an animal and sleeps with it, put the woman and the animal to death. Their blood is on their own heads.

“‘If a man takes his sister, whether she’s his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter, and they see each other naked, that’s shameful. They’ll be cut off in front of their people. He uncovered his sister’s nakedness, and he’ll answer for what he did.
“‘If a man sleeps with a woman during her period and uncovers her nakedness, he’s exposed the source of her flow, and she’s uncovered the source of her blood. Both will be cut off from their people.
“‘Don’t uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister or your father’s sister. That’s exposing a close relative. Both will answer for what they did.
If a man sleeps with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They’ll answer for their sin and die without children.
“‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, that’s unclean. He’s uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They’ll have no children.
“‘Keep all my laws and instructions and put them into practice so the land I’m bringing you to live in won’t throw you up.
Don’t copy the customs of the nation I’m driving out ahead of you. They did all these things, and that’s why I detested them.
But I told you, “You’ll inherit their land. I’ll give it to you to own, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I’m Yahweh your God, the one who separated you from the other peoples.

“‘So tell the difference between clean and unclean animals, and between clean and unclean birds. Don’t make yourselves detestable through any animal, bird, or creature crawling across the ground that I’ve marked off as unclean for you.
Be holy to me, because I, Yahweh, am holy. I’ve set you apart from the other peoples so you’ll be mine.
“‘Any man or woman who serves as a medium or a wizard must be put to death. They’ll be stoned. Their blood is on their own heads.’”
